title: St John’s rail crash of 1957
description: This plaque remembers the 90 people who died in the rail crash near St Johns station on 4 December 1957, and the St John’s residents who helped emergency services rescue those caught up in it. It was unveiled on 19 September 2026.
address: Brick wall on the approach to St Johns station, St Johns Vale, SE8 4EW
curation_note: Plaque location described by St John's Society and Salamander News. Coordinate marks the station, not the exact position on the approach wall.
